INSERT INTO rationale (signal_id, seq, venue, signal, observed, cmp, threshold, passed, note)
        SELECT * FROM UNNEST(
            $1::uuid[], $2::int[], $3::smallint[], $4::text[], $5::text[],
            $6::text[], $7::text[], $8::bool[], $9::text[]
        )
        ON CONFLICT (signal_id, seq) DO NOTHING
